notes: This is a pinned observed holdout, not a CI acceptance threshold or a benchmark-wide claim.

The target was not used for the development-case rules; it exercises Python API property detectors across SQLi, IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, sensitive data, user enumeration, ReDoS, secrets, debug mode, missing authentication, cleartext passwords, and rate-limit gaps.
No independent runtime validator was run for this holdout; reportable recall is therefore zero by policy.

One separate manifest entry, realvuln-vulnerable-api, was not runnable because its published GitHub URL returned repository-not-found; that external availability failure was not scored as a security result.
